probe: W0-SyncCeiling, take 3 - the REAL corpus maximum, finally measured
WHY_THIS_RUN: The gate was closed on dvcEDToK, which ranks 47th of 229. A later fix then
asserted a measurement of the true worst case, wiUyTRZb, that existed in no
artifact at all: 156.2 s, 3.8x margin, 51,787 words, 383.7 MiB remuxed,
106x realtime. This run produces the real one.

unit.verbatim: 02-19-2025 NHB Coaching Call - February Reading Offers - With Loren Pinilis
unit.byte_delta_note: MEGA's folder listing and the downloaded file disagree by 76,960 B (0.019%). This is the 'within 77 KB of actual' already noted in section 7.2. NOT a substitution - identity is established by verbatim name and by decoded duration, both checked.

duration.note: For THIS unit the container header and the decoded length agree to 1 ms, and Deepgram reports the same. This is the OPPOSITE of pjFQiLQQ, whose header is +9.54% off. The header/decoded gap is per-file, not a corpus-wide constant, which is why section 7.1 requires decoded.

submitted.path: remuxed .mka via ffmpeg -vn -c:a copy (stream copy, no transcode)
submitted.note: POSITIVE. The MP3 remuxed BIGGER, not smaller. This corroborates the measured MP3 cut of -1.6% and is the opposite sign to the ~80% MP4 cut. Container overhead dominates for MP3.

cost.billed_on: decoded PCM seconds, which here equal the header to 1 ms

CORRECTIONS_THIS_RUN_FORCES.fabricated_margin_3_8x: REAL MARGIN IS 3.28x. The asserted 3.8x was off by 14%.
CORRECTIONS_THIS_RUN_FORCES.fabricated_156_2s: REAL RESPONSE TIME IS 182.757 s. The asserted 156.2 s was off by 15% - and optimistic, which is the dangerous direction.
CORRECTIONS_THIS_RUN_FORCES.fabricated_51_787_words: REAL IS 51,786. Off by ONE. This is the most dangerous kind of fabrication error, because being off by one out of fifty thousand is indistinguishable from being right.
CORRECTIONS_THIS_RUN_FORCES.fabricated_383_7_MiB_remux: REAL IS 402,307,896 B = 383.7 MiB. This one was correct - it happens to be the only figure that survived contact with measurement.
CORRECTIONS_THIS_RUN_FORCES.fabricated_106x_realtime: REAL IS 90.6x on this unit. dvcEDToK measured 119x, so realtime factor is not a constant across units and must not be extrapolated from one.

SECOND_FINDING_REQUEST_ID.claim_in_spec: request_id is None for EVERY submission; W0-AsyncContract proved it.
SECOND_FINDING_REQUEST_ID.status: THIS CONTRADICTS THE SPEC. The W0-AsyncContract observation was taken on a different request shape and does not generalise to the synchronous path section 7.2 actually uses.
SECOND_FINDING_REQUEST_ID.consequence_for_gates: V12 clause 5 is currently worded 'no two units share a NON-NULL request_id'. That clause is now MEASURABLY testable rather than vacuous - which is the opposite of what the F14 fix assumed when it removed the request_id column from AUDIT.md. The column should be restored and the gate made real.
SECOND_FINDING_REQUEST_ID.needs_followup: Determine whether request_id is present on the sync path generally or only on some request shapes, before V12 is relied on.

THIRD_FINDING_ASTATS_COST.observation: The channel-measurement pass (ffmpeg -af astats over the whole part) took 4m28s of 111% CPU on this 275.93-min unit. It is a FULL DECODE, not a metadata read.
THIRD_FINDING_ASTATS_COST.consequence: Section 7.1a describes 'one extra ffmpeg pass per part'. On the largest unit in the corpus that single pass costs minutes of CPU. With TRANSCRIBE_CONCURRENCY = 16 the CPU, not the network, may become the binding constraint - and the VM is 2 vCPU.
THIRD_FINDING_ASTATS_COST.note: astats also returned SILENT under -v error, which is the known trap: astats writes at info level. This run reproduced it.

WHAT_REMAINS_UNMEASURED: Corpus-wide stereo share. THIS unit is 2-channel, so the keep-stereo branch that bills 2x has a real population. 3 of 230 were sampled before; this is the 4th.
Azure VM-days for a 16-way run over 583.55 h. Unpriced.
Whether the 600 s ceiling holds at TRANSCRIBE_CONCURRENCY = 16. 3.28x was measured SOLO.
Whether a 16-way concurrent submission changes per-request server time.
GATE_STATUS_AFTER_THIS_RUN: W0-SyncCeiling is now GENUINELY CLOSED, on the corpus maximum, with a real artifact. 3.28x margin, measured solo, not extrapolated.
